svg.title: Pulsus Dash — Span point cloud 3D: 10⁷ checkout spans by time, duration and route
svg.desc: 3D point cloud of about ten million checkout spans during INC-2041: X = time 11:50–12:40, Y = span duration on a log scale from 1 ms to 10 s, Z = one lane per http.route. Calm spans are drawn with density alpha and fade with depth fog; error spans are in the Failing colour; psp-api client-timeout spans form a flat glowing sheet at exactly 2.000 s in the /payment/authorize lane after 12:22. A 3D box selection around the sheet drives a linked 2D attribute-divergence panel that ranks attributes as different (peer.service = psp-api, error.type = timeout, timeout_ms = 2000 set at 12:19) or unchanged. An inset shows the same data flattened to a 2D scatter (T toggle). HUD: lane and colour dropdowns, selection tools, camera presets, orbit gizmo, data badge, coverage meter and per-axis zoom hint.
